description: Every visual LynkOmni needs, declared in one place. Add a need here, then run python3 visuals/generate.py. Never add a picture by hand and never leave a placeholder: python3 visuals/check.py fails the build if a need has no file, a file has no need, or anything is off-brand. All assets are drafts until a human designer reviews them.
